verdict.rationale: Sentry's official MCP server lets AI assistants search errors and triage issues. Its public API (OpenAPI spec) lists project issues and supports bulk mutation, so the pull-and-triage part of the story is directly supported. Nothing in the evidence shows an agent filing bugs into an external tracker via API or MCP; the coding-agent integrations create pull requests, not tracker tickets. Missing for 10: documented filing of issues into an external tracker (Jira/GitHub Issues) via API or MCP, explicit evidence that stack traces are returned through MCP/API, and hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end agent workflow.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can pull my top production issues with stack traces via API or MCP, triage them, and file the real bugs into my tracker

citations.quote: Connects AI assistants to Sentry for searching errors, analyzing performance, triaging issues, reading documentation, and managing projects — all via the Model Context Protocol.
Sentry MCP: fix production issues right from your LLM
Bulk Mutate a List of Issues
the interactive developer CLI with issue management, AI-powered analysis, and API access for humans and agents
